name_zh: X京张实施前预可行性交接
claim_boundary_zh: 本文件只规定专业团队接手后的填数、核验和责任落位方法，不提供现场实测、正式红线、施工尺寸、工程容量、人民币预算、采购决定、资金承诺、保险或机构授权。所有未取得可签证据的项目保持TO_VERIFY、UNASSIGNED或HOLD。
claim_boundary_en: This file defines how a professional team should measure, verify and assign responsibility after handoff. It does not provide field survey, official redlines, construction dimensions, engineering capacity, CNY budget, procurement decisions, funding commitments, insurance or institutional authorisation. Every item without signable evidence remains TO_VERIFY, UNASSIGNED or HOLD.
review_readiness_effect: These statuses block only future field launch or statutory delivery. They are not current participant-controlled repairs or blockers for formal review of this concept package.

scale_and_quantity_chain.current_basis_zh: 临时总体边界、公开地图语境和九公里级概念联系
scale_and_quantity_chain.current_basis_en: provisional overall geometry, public map context and the corridor-scale concept relationship
scale_and_quantity_chain.handoff_output_zh: 站点顺序、城市接口和需深化区段，不产生工程量
scale_and_quantity_chain.handoff_output_en: station sequence, civic interfaces and sections requiring development; no implementation quantities
scale_and_quantity_chain.required_next_evidence_zh: 组织方正式边界、坐标口径、权属和控规
scale_and_quantity_chain.required_next_evidence_en: organiser-issued official geometry, CRS basis, ownership and statutory controls

scale_and_quantity_chain.current_basis_zh: 三站概念拓扑、现有设计动作和候选公共用途
scale_and_quantity_chain.current_basis_en: three-station concept topology, current design moves and candidate ordinary uses
scale_and_quantity_chain.handoff_output_zh: 需测绘的公众主线、AI侧线、道岔和折返接口清单
scale_and_quantity_chain.handoff_output_en: survey list for the civic mainline, AI siding, turnout and return interfaces
scale_and_quantity_chain.required_next_evidence_zh: 现状测绘、管理边界、交通人流、消防、防洪和无障碍审计
scale_and_quantity_chain.required_next_evidence_en: existing-condition survey, management boundary, movement, fire, flood and accessibility audits

scale_and_quantity_chain.current_basis_zh: 可逆四件套、三站首期交付包和14日受控运行工况
scale_and_quantity_chain.current_basis_en: the four-part reversible kit, station first-phase packages and 14-day controlled operating fixtures
scale_and_quantity_chain.handoff_output_zh: 按专业拆分的构件、服务、设备和复原工程量清单框架
scale_and_quantity_chain.handoff_output_en: discipline-based bill-of-quantities framework for components, services, equipment and restoration
scale_and_quantity_chain.required_next_evidence_zh: 核定布置、设备配置、材料、施工方法、运行时段和复原基线
scale_and_quantity_chain.required_next_evidence_en: verified layout, equipment configuration, materials, construction method, operating hours and restoration baseline

scale_and_quantity_chain.current_basis_zh: 公众连续、独立关闭、人工接管、非AI服务和失败复原要求
scale_and_quantity_chain.current_basis_en: civic continuity, independent closure, human takeover, non-AI service and failed-restoration requirements
scale_and_quantity_chain.handoff_output_zh: 规范、厂商参数和风险分析共同决定的接口验收表
scale_and_quantity_chain.handoff_output_en: interface acceptance schedule determined by codes, manufacturer parameters and hazard analysis
scale_and_quantity_chain.required_next_evidence_zh: 适用规范、设备技术文件、现场风险评估和专业签注
scale_and_quantity_chain.required_next_evidence_en: applicable codes, equipment technical files, field risk assessment and professional sign-off

quantity_workflow: freeze official geometry, ownership and ordinary-use baseline
freeze the declared scene, product version, route and operating hours
measure components, services, equipment and restoration quantities by discipline
check quantities against applicable codes, manufacturer parameters and hazard analysis
issue a versioned quantity schedule; any material configuration change returns the estimate to HOLD

cost_accounts.includes_zh: 测绘与设计、可逆构件、公共空间适配、无障碍调整、临时测试设备、必要数字与机电接入
cost_accounts.includes_en: survey and design, reversible components, public-space adaptation, accessibility works, temporary test equipment and necessary digital or MEP connections

cost_accounts.includes_zh: 值守、人工等价服务、能源通信、数据治理、保险、清洁和日常运营
cost_accounts.includes_en: duty staffing, staffed equivalent service, energy and communications, data governance, insurance, cleaning and daily operations

cost_accounts.includes_zh: 检查、备件、维修、软件与安全更新、设备替换和无障碍服务维持
cost_accounts.includes_en: inspection, spares, repair, software and safety updates, equipment replacement and accessibility-service continuity

cost_accounts.includes_zh: 断能、拆除、运输、数据删除、场地恢复、普通用途复核和缺陷整改
cost_accounts.includes_en: isolation, removal, transport, data deletion, site reinstatement, ordinary-use review and defect correction

resource_band_mapping.S: Uses primarily existing space and staff, research, audits, signs or simple temporary elements; actual labour, permissions and reinstatement still require costing.
resource_band_mapping.M: Adds removable components or specialist services; requires measured quantities, dated quotations and an operating-hours basis.
resource_band_mapping.L: Introduces engineering interfaces or long-term operations; requires a separate statutory, engineering, procurement and lifecycle-cost case.

required_inputs: dated and location-relevant unit-rate source or supplier quotation
rom_cost_method.hold_if: Any required input, accountable estimator, funding route or restoration provision is absent.

capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_zh: 现场负荷调查、接入条件、隔离和断能方案、设备厂商参数
capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_en: field load survey, connection conditions, isolation plan and manufacturer parameters
capacity_entry_gate.verification_role: qualified electrical engineer and site asset holder
capacity_entry_gate.action_if_unmet: HOLD; reduce equipment demand, relocate or do not open the AI function

capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_zh: 覆盖、冗余、离线降级、网络安全和数据期限方案
capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_en: coverage, resilience, offline fallback, cybersecurity and data-expiry plan
capacity_entry_gate.action_if_unmet: HOLD; retain staffed and non-digital service only

capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_zh: 地形、排水、防洪和天气停运条件
capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_en: topography, drainage, flood and weather shutdown conditions
capacity_entry_gate.verification_role: drainage or flood professional and site manager
capacity_entry_gate.action_if_unmet: HOLD; relocate, seasonally restrict or remove the unit

capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_zh: 消防条件、疏散、急停、救援到达和电池/设备处置方案
capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_en: fire conditions, egress, emergency stop, response access and battery or equipment response plan

capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_zh: 现场连续路线审计、告知理解、人工服务和技术关闭状态复核
capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_en: field continuous-route audit, notice comprehension, staffed service and technology-closed-state review
capacity_entry_gate.action_if_unmet: HOLD; restore the ordinary public route and staffed service

capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_zh: 维护时段、人员权限、备件、故障隔离和不占用公众主线的到达方案
capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_en: maintenance hours, access authority, spares, fault isolation and access without occupying the civic mainline
capacity_entry_gate.action_if_unmet: HOLD; remove the device or reduce the operating envelope

capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_zh: 失效设备撤出路线、搬运方式、临时存放和复原清单
capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_en: failed-equipment recovery route, handling method, temporary storage and reinstatement schedule
capacity_entry_gate.verification_role: operator, safety lead and restoration decision maker
capacity_entry_gate.action_if_unmet: HOLD; no test or limited public use

capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_zh: 涉及顶棚、平台、设备基础或附着构件时的结构调查与荷载复核
capacity_entry_gate.required_evidence_en: structural survey and load review where canopies, platforms, equipment bases or attached elements are involved
capacity_entry_gate.verification_role: qualified structural engineer and asset holder
capacity_entry_gate.action_if_unmet: HOLD; use a non-attached alternative or omit the element

implementation_responsibility_matrix.evidence_required: title or delegated site authority and signed site conditions
implementation_responsibility_matrix.handoff_responsibility: provide survey, controls, utilities and asset constraints

implementation_responsibility_matrix.decision_right: coordinate scope, programme and evidence register without overriding professional holds
implementation_responsibility_matrix.handoff_responsibility: maintain the versioned scope, quantity and decision log
implementation_responsibility_matrix.exit_responsibility: close contracts, records and unresolved defects

implementation_responsibility_matrix.decision_right: open, pause or stop only within signed permissions
implementation_responsibility_matrix.evidence_required: legal identity, operating responsibility, insurance and duty roster
implementation_responsibility_matrix.handoff_responsibility: accept operating, staffing and maintenance procedures
implementation_responsibility_matrix.exit_responsibility: stop service, isolate equipment and support restoration

implementation_responsibility_matrix.decision_right: issue or retain a safety HOLD and exercise stop authority
implementation_responsibility_matrix.evidence_required: competence, signed safety case and emergency plan
implementation_responsibility_matrix.handoff_responsibility: approve fixtures, stop drills and incident routes

implementation_responsibility_matrix.decision_right: block opening when route or equivalent service fails
implementation_responsibility_matrix.evidence_required: named reviewer, affected-user participation and field audit
implementation_responsibility_matrix.handoff_responsibility: sign the route, notice and staffed-service checks
implementation_responsibility_matrix.exit_responsibility: confirm ordinary accessible use after restoration

implementation_responsibility_matrix.decision_right: authorise or refuse data processing within the declared purpose
implementation_responsibility_matrix.evidence_required: legal identity, data inventory, lawful basis, expiry and complaint route
implementation_responsibility_matrix.handoff_responsibility: accept the data and rights impact record
implementation_responsibility_matrix.exit_responsibility: prove deletion, retention or lawful transfer

implementation_responsibility_matrix.decision_right: declare equipment unavailable and require repair or removal
implementation_responsibility_matrix.evidence_required: maintenance plan, competence, spares and response route
implementation_responsibility_matrix.handoff_responsibility: accept asset register and maintenance baseline
implementation_responsibility_matrix.exit_responsibility: remove equipment and close maintenance liabilities

implementation_responsibility_matrix.decision_right: withhold RESTORE until ordinary use and defects are closed
implementation_responsibility_matrix.evidence_required: funding provision, baseline record and signable acceptance method
implementation_responsibility_matrix.handoff_responsibility: approve the removal and restoration plan before opening
implementation_responsibility_matrix.exit_responsibility: sign reinstatement or issue a corrective-action HOLD

paths.future_review_zh: 先核对知识产权、设备所有权、研究协议、场地责任和退出处置，再决定是否允许研究使用。
paths.future_review_en: First verify intellectual property, equipment ownership, research agreement, site responsibility and exit disposition before permitting research use.

paths.future_review_zh: 由法务与采购专业人员根据主体、公共资金、保险、期限和复原责任选择临时协议或适用采购程序。
paths.future_review_en: Legal and procurement professionals select a temporary agreement or applicable procurement process based on parties, public funding, insurance, duration and restoration responsibility.

paths.future_review_zh: 只有在绩效要求、服务等价、维护、数据、退出和生命周期资金闭合后，才可形成独立运营或采购论证。
paths.future_review_en: A separate operations or procurement case may proceed only after performance, service equivalence, maintenance, data, exit and lifecycle funding are closed.

procurement_path_note.boundary: No supplier, procurement route, award, funding source or contract is selected or implied by this concept package.

global_hard_blocks: official geometry or required survey evidence absent
required capacity evidence absent or failed
quantity or ROM basis not versioned and attributable
insurance, permission, funding or restoration provision absent
procurement or contract route not lawfully selected for the asset or service type
